notes: Online scores and gift requests no longer pile up: a refused request is dropped at once, and a run submit goes ahead of waiting polls.
Gift inbox checks run on their normal schedule again, instead of retrying every few seconds.
Right click and Esc cancel the refinery placement.
Runs with achievements are accepted again: the achievement catalogue is seeded on the server, so scores reach the boards.
Weekly challenge runs send their challenge result, so they show on the week board.
Warden bosses show a health bar and a shield bar above them in the world.
Right click switches auto buy off again; the AUTO label and the active strip follow the click at once.
Wardens spawn at the full spawn radius again and walk the maze instead of getting stuck in one-cell gaps.
Every enemy follows the maze, flyers included.
The enemy speed in the info card shows the slowed value while a slow is active.
Collectors are drawn smaller, and the unit auras sit tight around the model.
Unit auras take the colour of the ore they carry.
The arena has a plain black background with the grid only; the space backdrop is switched off for now.
Failed score uploads show in the leaderboard, so you can see when a run did not reach the server.
Run submits reach the leaderboards again: the game now sends the four-part version the server expects, so your runs appear on the Champion, This week and Weekly boards.
Graphics quality presets Low, Medium (the default, the 1.0 look) and High (desktop only, extra effects such as shadows, glow, particles and sparkle).
Sound effects for towers, hits, deaths, boss, core, ore, building, selling, upgrades, refining, levels, achievements and wave starts, with volume settings.
Collectors and haulers have their own unit models, drawn larger and animated.
Smoother play on large maps: the flow field, the tooltips and the UI update only when something changed, and the sky nebula builds over several frames.
Ore piles and pickups, and enemies and shots, move on the GPU between simulation steps.
Drag and mass select show the ingot price of ingot towers.
Ingot towers place one at a time, as in the 2D game.
Web build loads the sky without a long stall.
Full 3D port of Dynty Tower Defense up to tin: towers, ores iron, copper and tin, with the same rules and balance as the 2D game.
Wardens (spawners) that you control: raise or lower the pressure on your base with the spawn control.
Collectors and haulers that gather ore and bring it to the core, with calm collection as a core feature.
Refining and crafting: smelt ore into ingots and craft from them, with a refine queue in the HUD.
Talent tree and achievements that carry across runs in your profile.
Online leaderboard, profile save slots (no login), gifts, duels, quick chat and news; the game runs offline and syncs when online.
Maze share: send your maze layout to other players.
Web version with a loading screen and fullscreen start, playable in the browser without installing anything.
Windows desktop build with a 3D arena, build menu, HUD and hover tooltips for towers, ores and enemies.
